description.zh: agent 执行任务时按快捷键弹出临时小窗，用 DeepSeek 流式解释概念，可按需开启联网搜索与读链接；不创建 Session、不写 session log、不调用 agent 工具，关掉即走。
description.en: A shortcut opens a temporary overlay during an agent task and streams explanations from DeepSeek, with optional web search and link reading; no session, no session log, and no agent tools.
